Case for buying HIGGS now is weak, and I don't think the brief supports one.

The strongest data point is the last 15 minutes: 1,407 buyers, $214k volume, net flow +31 SOL, and a +26% return. That suggests live interest. But the 30-minute return is -24%, the coin is 44% off its 30-minute high, and sells are 865 SOL against 896 SOL of buys, so the rally is being met by heavy distribution.

Structure is the bigger problem. The curve shows bundle_share 1.0 and completer_share 1.04, meaning the early buying was bundled, not organic. Top-3 holders control 87% of the curve, and the launch bot was present. The "ORGANIC" class label doesn't match these concentration and bundling signals. Against base rates (about -20% for random alive buys at this age, and the coin is already in drawdown), I can't make an honest case that demand will hold for the next 30-60 minutes. I recommend skipping.
